intent: A subscription's invoice email, when one is given, must look like a real email address (a name, an @, then a host).
notes: Pattern family. NON-iterating (error field in the non-repeatable Billing group). The violation is 'present but ill-formed', so it pairs a positive presence guard (FieldFilled) with PatternViolated (not PatternMatched) — getting the regex polarity right is the test: matching the pattern is the GOOD case, so the rule must fire on a violation of it. Bracketed ref on the left of the pattern op; bare ref inside FieldFilled.
